summary: LDAP authenticator settings in AAP: Additional Authenticator Fields override the UI fields, LDAP Connection Options such as OPT_REFERRALS: 0 and OPT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT: 30 (referrals are off by default for Active Directory), LDAP Group Type Parameters like name_attr cn and member_attr member, and LDAP Group Search as base DN, SCOPE_SUBTREE and filter.
questions: How do I disable LDAP referrals in AAP?
What are LDAP Group Type Parameters in AAP?
How do I set the LDAP group search in AAP 2.6?
Why do LDAP queries hang with Active Directory?

answer_card.title: LDAP connection and group search
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
# LDAP Connection Options
OPT_REFERRALS: 0
OPT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT: 30
```

```json
// LDAP Group Type Parameters
{"name_attr": "cn", "member_attr": "member"}
```

```json
// LDAP Group Search
["dc=example,dc=com", "SCOPE_SUBTREE", "(objectClass=group)"]
```

Referrals are off by default so queries against Active Directory don't hang.
